g.text: SD07: Ask the Assistant through the CLI JSON mode (UC13; feature F10; Stage 3 KUMA entry point)
runs execute(), then print(), and maps
errors to a non-zero exit code.
From the GUI, the AML Analyst uses
Agent loop as in SD04, from systemPrompt() to finish(outcome):
LLM calls, validated tool calls, trace recording.
The system prompt tells the agent to treat text
found in data (for example transaction memos)
JSON on stdout; exit code 0 (or non-zero on error)
